Hi Sam / Erin 

Thanks again for the call today 

- great to hear more about Acme's ingestion pipeline and the evaluation priorities. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the proposed POC scope, success criteria, and immediate next steps so we can align on owners and timeline.

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood inference for Acme's "customer-360 summarization" workflow at production-like latency and cost.

Success criteria (agreed on call):
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 512-token requests in your eu-west staging region (traffic profile: 60% short, 40% long).
2) Accuracy: model outputs meet your heuristic score threshold (F1-like measure) on the 500-sample eval set you shared.
3) Cost: per-1000-token cost <= $X (we'll refine once we see tokens in the trial).
4) Integration: streaming generation + function/tool-calling works with your existing event processor (Kafka) and the Node.js service.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Exchange eval dataset and access (you to share S3/Drive link).
- Week 1: Redwood provides a trial account + sample SDK integration snippets; quick integration support from Rishi.
- Week 2: Run ingest + 500-sample eval; collect latency/cost metrics and model outputs.
- Week 3: Review results, tune batching/quantization recommendations, and decide on next steps (extend trial or move to Dedicated).

Owners:
- Acme: share eval dataset, provide staging env access (Erin).
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead), Rishi (integration & infra support), Stephanie (customer success / onboarding).

Immediate next steps:
1) Erin: share the 500-sample eval set and a staging Kafka topic + service account by EOD Thursday (7/30).
2) Redwood: attach POC plan and SDK guide (see attachments) and spin up trial account. Rishi will set up a 30-min tech kickoff once we have staging details.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, redwood-sdk-integration-guide.md (snippets for Node/Python, streaming examples).

If that aligns, I'll schedule the kickoff for next week.

Thanks

Thanks Sam 

quick tech note & an integration plan so your engineers can start while paperwork is processed. Posting the high-level steps here; I can share a short runnable Node example in the kickoff.

Integration plan (high level):
1) Trial account & creds
   - Redwood will create a trial API key scoped to your org + an integration user for the staging Kafka sink.

2) SDK & API routes
   - Use our Node SDK for quick start (npm install @redwoodai/inference).
   - Core endpoints: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (sync) and POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream (streaming via chunked HTTP / SSE).
   - Function/tool calling: include `tools` in the request JSON and set `tool_calling: "auto"` to allow the model to emit structured function calls. The SDK decodes function_call events into an event you can hook into.

3) Streaming behavior
   - Our streaming endpoint emits incremental JSON chunks with fields: {"token":"...","delta":"...","type":"content|tool_call|end"}. The Node SDK exposes an async iterator (for await ... of client.stream(...)) so your service can pipe tokens to the client UI as they arrive.
   - For tool calls, you'll receive a chunk with type="tool_call" and a payload with the function name + args; reply to the flow by calling POST /v1/tool-response with the call id and the tool output. Redwood will continue generation after the tool response is posted.

4) SDK integration snippets (Node):
   - Initialize: const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: 'eu-west' });
   - Streaming example: const stream = client.stream({ model: 'rw-instruct-large', prompt, max_tokens: 512, tool_calling: 'auto' });
     for await (const evt of stream) { if (evt.type === 'content') socket.send(evt.delta); if (evt.type === 'tool_call') { /* call internal resolver */ } }

5) Batch / Cost knobs
   - We recommend starting with conservative batching (max_batch_latency_ms: 50) and enable prefix KV cache for repeated contexts. Rishi will provide recommended settings after first run.

Attachments: I pushed a short tech appendix to the Drive link (redwood-sdk-integration-guide.md) with sample request/response payloads and the chunk schema.

Let me know what else you need ahead of the kickoff. I can do the tech kickoff Tue 8/4 9:30 AM PT if that works.
